mimic_disease: SCN1A or STXBP1-related Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathies
discriminating_logic: While SCN1A/STXBP1 DEEs present predominantly with refractory early seizures and non-dysmorphic features, KLHL20 patients frequently demonstrate prominent behavioral alterations (hyperactivity, stereotypies, aggressive outbursts, autistic traits) alongside seizures.
